		parliament_type = parliament_type:antq_commagenean_royal_council
	}
	chance = { add = 1 }
	on_debate_passed = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = antq_issue_commagenean_dynastic_domain_hearing_outcome years = 10 mode = add_and_extend }
	}
	on_debate_failed = { parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes }
}
